title: When Chekhov's Gun Fires Anyway: Over-Realization in Text-to-Image Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.16630v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In text-to-image generation, a target that the prompt mentions often appears in the generated image in a way the prompt does not call for. We call this failure over-realization. Mental-spaces theory points to the situations where it can happen: under a negation, inside what a character believes or imagines, as the vehicle of a figurative comparison, or behind a viewpoint that hides the target. Prior work has studied only negation in depth, and the conventional alignment and preference metrics do not penalize the failure. We build OverReal to measure it: OverReal-Gen, 698 prompts covering the four situations, on which we measure each generator's over-realization rate; and OverReal-Det, 2,841 generated images human-labeled for whether and how the target is over-realized, on which we verify the automatic judge that produces this rate. translated_title: 当“契诃夫之枪”依然开火：文生图模型中的过度实现现象
translated_abstract: 在文本到图像生成中，提示词所提及的目标常常以提示词并未要求的方式出现在生成的图像中。我们将这种失败称为“过度实现”。心理空间理论指出了这类情况可能发生的场景：在否定句中、在角色所相信或想象的内容之中、作为比喻性比较的喻体，或在遮挡目标的视角之下。先前的工作仅深入研究过否定这一种情形，而常规的对齐与偏好类指标并不会惩罚这种失败。我们构建了 OverReal 来测量它：OverReal-Gen 包含覆盖上述四种情形的 698 条提示词，用于测量每个生成器的过度实现率；OverReal-Det 包含 2,841 张经人工标注“目标是否以及如何被过度实现”的生成图像，用于验证产生该比率的自动裁判。我们对八个文生图系统的评估显示，它们全部存在过度实现现象，且常规的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出 OverReal 基准（覆盖否定、心理状态、比喻、视角遮挡四类语境的 698 条提示词及 2,841 张人工标注图像），首次系统测量文生图模型中提示词未要求出现的目标仍被生成的“过度实现”失败，发现全部八个受测系统均存在该问题，而现有对齐与偏好指标无法检测到它。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OverReal, a benchmark of 698 prompts across four linguistic contexts (negation, mental states, figurative comparison, viewpoint occlusion) plus 2,841 human-labeled images, to systematically measure "over-realization" in text-to-image models—finding that all eight evaluated systems exhibit this failure and that conventional alignment and preference metrics fail to catch it.
